name: 2026-09-stocks-mean-reversion-v2
hypothesis: RSI mean reversion (35/65) on a 12-ticker equity basket, with discretionary exits gated below break-even, produces a positive per-trade edge that BEATS BUY-AND-HOLD after costs. v1 was voided on 2026-09-01 after the trailing stop was found able to close positions below entry.

config.exit_invariant: discretionary exits blocked below break-even; stop-loss exempt

success_criteria.note: EFFECTIVE trades. 12 tickers measure as 4.9 independent symbols, so pooled counts overstate evidence ~2.4x.
success_criteria.power_caveat: At the measured per-trade Sharpe of 0.074 a conclusive test needs ~700 independent trades. This run cannot confirm a small edge; it can detect a large one or rule out a disaster.
success_criteria.watch_for: The gate holds losers longer by design. If average loss grows faster than average win, the fix has become the loss-aversion trap and must be reverted.

stopping_rule: Stop at 2026-10-01 OR 20 effective trades, whichever is later. No configuration change before then except a defect that stops trades executing or makes an exit unable to profit. A parameter change restarts the clock and voids this registration.
notes: Exit invariant added 2026-09-01 to both markets: a discretionary exit (trailing stop, strategy signal) may not close a position at a net loss. Stop-loss exempt. Crypto stays parked; the same invariant was applied there and walk-forward over 500 days cut its loss from -$2.64 to -$1.13 without beating buy-and-hold in any variant (17/45 folds).
verdict: VOIDED, not a result. Position size raised $10 -> $100 on 2026-09-04 at the operator's request, to see dollar figures at the intended scale. Percentage returns are scale-invariant, so the evidence is unchanged; the registration is re-sealed because trade_amount_usd is a sealed field. Superseded by 2026-09-stocks-mean-reversion-v3.
